verdict: Sales jumped 22% to $1.56B on strong semiconductor demand in both segments, but GAAP profit fell as the newly independent company took on its own interest bill and $53M of spin-off transformation costs.

kpis.label: EPS (GAAP)
kpis.note: Down 14% YoY; adjusted EPS was $1.46, up 55%

kpis.label: Adjusted Operating EBITDA
kpis.note: 32.3% of sales, up from $370M pro forma a year ago

segments.name: Semiconductor Technologies
segments.note: Materials and solutions used to make semiconductor chips

segments.name: Interconnect Solutions
segments.note: Materials that connect chips and carry signals in advanced electronics

opex.name: Transformation, integration and other charges
opex.note: Costs of becoming independent from DuPont, including IT separation

opex.name: Amortization of intangibles
opex.note: Spreading the cost of intangible assets over their lives

flow.otherDetail: Other income is interest expense ($64M) plus $39M of other expense, net — the $39M includes indirect legacy costs from DuPont spin-off cost-sharing arrangements. Equity is equity earnings of nonconsolidated affiliates ($15M) minus $13M of profit belonging to noncontrolling interests, so net income is the $183M available for Qnity common stockholders (total net income was $196M).

takeaways.title: Both segments grew double digits
takeaways.text: Net sales rose to $1,556M from $1,276M a year ago. Interconnect Solutions grew 30% to $759M and Semiconductor Technologies grew 15% to $797M.

takeaways.title: Adjusted profit surged
takeaways.text: Adjusted EPS was $1.46, up 55% year over year, and adjusted operating EBITDA rose to $503M. Qnity raised full-year 2026 guidance for sales, EBITDA and EPS.

takeaways.title: GAAP EPS fell despite the sales jump
takeaways.text: GAAP EPS was $0.87, down from $1.01 a year ago, as interest expense rose to $64M and transformation and spin-off costs weighed on profit.

oneTimers: Transformation, integration and other charges of $53M, including about $35M for IT independence from DuPont
Indirect legacy costs of $39M from DuPont spin-off cost-sharing arrangements, recorded in other expense
footerNote: Qnity was spun off from DuPont on November 1, 2025; prior-year figures in the release are pro forma for the spin-off where noted. Operating income here is gross profit minus the listed operating expenses, before equity earnings, interest and other expense — it reconciles to Qnity's reported $247M of income before income taxes.
follow100Note: Other income in this breakdown combines the other-income and equity lines from the flow, so the rows add to the net margin.
